panels.title: Usage · last 5 h
panels.description: Cost (cost_usd) per Claude account over the last 5 hours. Bar = that cost as % of the account's peak: its highest rolling 5-hour cost over the last 30 days (10-minute steps). Green below 60 %, yellow from 60 %, red from 80 %. Fixed windows: ignores the dashboard time range and the variables. Accounts with no cost in 7 days are not listed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    concat(if(t.label = '', '(no account)', t.label), '  ·  $', toString(round(t.h5, 2))) AS name,
    round(100 * t.h5 / greatest(p.peak, t.h5, 0.000001)) AS pct
FROM
(
    SELECT account_uuid,
           argMax(account, ts) AS label,
           sumIf(cost_usd, ts >= now() - INTERVAL 5 HOUR) AS h5,
           sumIf(cost_usd, ts >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS d7
    FROM cc.api_requests
    WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    GROUP BY account_uuid
) AS t
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT account_uuid, max(w) AS peak
    FROM
    (
        SELECT account_uuid,
               sum(c) OVER (PARTITION BY account_uuid ORDER BY b RANGE BETWEEN 17999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS w
        FROM
        (
            SELECT account_uuid, toUInt32(toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)) AS b, sum(cost_usd) AS c
            FROM cc.api_requests
            WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
            GROUP BY account_uuid, b
        )
    )
    GROUP BY account_uuid
) AS p ON p.account_uuid = t.account_uuid
WHERE t.d7 > 0
ORDER BY t.h5 DESC, t.d7 DESC

panels.title: Tips · 7 d

panels.description: The most frequent tip category (view cc.tips, last 7 days) with its count in brackets (ties: alphabetical order). Click the value to open the Tips section of the Efficiency dashboard. Ignores the dashboard time range and the variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(tips = 0, 'none', concat(multiIf(top = 'cache', 'Cache rebuilds', top = 'repeated-read', 'Repeated reads', top = 'big-results', 'Big tool results', top = 'short-opus', 'Short Opus answers', top = 'agent-outlier', 'Costly agent run', top = 'denials', 'Denied tool calls', top = 'slow-hook', 'Slow hooks', top = 'slow-ttft', 'Slow first token', top), ' (', toString(n), ')')) AS most_frequent
FROM
(
    SELECT sum(c) AS tips,
           argMin(category, (-toInt64(c), category)) AS top,
           max(c) AS n
    FROM (SELECT category, count() AS c FROM cc.tips GROUP BY category)
)

panels.title: Summary
panels.description: filtered by all variables

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Sessions with at least one model request in the range (honours all filters). The same rule everywhere: a session counts only if it had a model request.

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Turns
panels.description: Model requests of the main conversation (actor = main). Requests of agents and auxiliary calls are not counted.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, count() AS turns FROM cc.api_requests WHERE actor = 'main' AND ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Input
panels.description: Input tokens: new, non-cached prompt text sent to the model.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, sum(input_tokens) AS input FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Output
panels.description: Output tokens: text and tool calls generated by the model.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, sum(output_tokens) AS output FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cache read
panels.description: Tokens served from the prompt cache. Much cheaper than input, so a high value is good.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, sum(cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cache create
panels.description: Tokens written to the prompt cache (priced above normal input).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, sum(cache_creation_tokens) AS cache_create FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cost
panels.description: Cost in USD as reported by Claude Code (cost_usd).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, sum(cost_usd) AS cost FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Daily work
panels.description: Tokens per day. Input: new non-cached prompt text. Output: generated by the model. Cache create: written to the prompt cache. Cache read is a separate chart: it is 10-100x larger and would flatten this one. Days are in server time (UTC).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(ts) AS time, sum(input_tokens) AS input, sum(output_tokens) AS output, sum(cache_creation_tokens) AS cache_create
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Daily cache reads
panels.description: Cache read tokens per day. Cache reads are much cheaper than regular input, so high values are good. Days are in server time (UTC).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(ts) AS time, sum(cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cache hit rate
panels.description: cache read / (cache read + input + cache create). Below 40 % red, 40-70 % yellow, above 70 % green.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100 * sum(cache_read_tokens) / greatest(sum(cache_read_tokens + input_tokens + cache_creation_tokens), 1) AS hit_rate FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Cache hit rate by project
panels.description: Same formula per effective project. Thresholds: 40 % and 70 %.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT project, 100 * sum(cache_read_tokens) / greatest(sum(cache_read_tokens + input_tokens + cache_creation_tokens), 1) AS hit_rate
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY project ORDER BY hit_rate DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Tokens by project
panels.description: Total tokens (input + output + cache) and cost per effective project; unknown = project could not be determined. Click a project to filter the dashboard by it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT project, sum(total_tokens) AS tokens, sum(cost_usd) AS cost
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY project ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Model share
panels.description: Share of tokens by model; the cost of each model is in its legend label.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(model, ' ($', toString(round(sum(cost_usd), 2)), ')') AS model_cost, sum(total_tokens) AS tokens
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Top tools
panels.description: Top 10 tools by number of calls (all variables and the time range apply).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT tool_name, count() AS calls
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Recent sessions (click session_id to drill down)
panels.description: Ten latest sessions in the time range (project and session variables apply). cache_hit_pct = cache reads / (input + cache reads + cache creation).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.session_id AS session_id, s.started AS started, s.project AS project,
       if(s.title != '', s.title, leftUTF8(replaceAll(s.first_prompt, '\n', ' '), 100)) AS name, s.git_branch AS git_branch,
       round(s.cost_usd, 3) AS cost_usd, s.tokens AS tokens,
       round(r.hit * 100, 1) AS cache_hit_pct,
       dateDiff('minute', s.started, s.last_event) AS minutes
FROM cc.sessions AS s
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT session_id, sum(cache_read_tokens) / greatest(sum(cache_read_tokens) + sum(input_tokens) + sum(cache_creation_tokens), 1) AS hit
  FROM cc.api_requests
  WHERE session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM cc.sessions
    WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}')
      AND requests > 0 AND started >= $__fromTime AND started <= $__toTime
    ORDER BY started DESC LIMIT 10)
  GROUP BY session_id
) AS r ON r.session_id = s.session_id
WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR s.account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR s.project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR s.session_id = '${session}')
  AND s.requests > 0
  AND s.started >= $__fromTime AND s.started <= $__toTime
ORDER BY s.started DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT actor, sum(total_tokens) AS tokens
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY actor ORDER BY tokens DESC

SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, actor, sum(cost_usd) AS cost
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY time, actor ORDER BY time

panels.title: Active sessions (last 15 min)
panels.description: Sessions with an event in the last 15 minutes: LIVE = under 2 minutes ago, IDLE = under 15. Ignores the time range; project and session variables apply.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT session_id, project, host,
       if(last_event >= now() - INTERVAL 2 MINUTE, 'LIVE', 'IDLE') AS status,
       round(cost_usd, 3) AS cost_usd,
       dateDiff('second', last_event, now()) AS seconds_ago
FROM cc.sessions
WHERE last_event >= now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE AND requests > 0
  AND ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}')
ORDER BY last_event DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Coding rhythm (model requests by weekday and hour)
panels.description: Model requests per weekday (rows) and hour (columns, server time zone, UTC in Docker) in the time range; darker = more requests. All variables apply.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ['Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat','Sun'][toDayOfWeek(ts)] AS day,
       countIf(toHour(ts) = 0) AS `00`, countIf(toHour(ts) = 1) AS `01`, countIf(toHour(ts) = 2) AS `02`, countIf(toHour(ts) = 3) AS `03`,
       countIf(toHour(ts) = 4) AS `04`, countIf(toHour(ts) = 5) AS `05`, countIf(toHour(ts) = 6) AS `06`, countIf(toHour(ts) = 7) AS `07`,
       countIf(toHour(ts) = 8) AS `08`, countIf(toHour(ts) = 9) AS `09`, countIf(toHour(ts) = 10) AS `10`, countIf(toHour(ts) = 11) AS `11`,
       countIf(toHour(ts) = 12) AS `12`, countIf(toHour(ts) = 13) AS `13`, countIf(toHour(ts) = 14) AS `14`, countIf(toHour(ts) = 15) AS `15`,
       countIf(toHour(ts) = 16) AS `16`, countIf(toHour(ts) = 17) AS `17`, countIf(toHour(ts) = 18) AS `18`, countIf(toHour(ts) = 19) AS `19`,
       countIf(toHour(ts) = 20) AS `20`, countIf(toHour(ts) = 21) AS `21`, countIf(toHour(ts) = 22) AS `22`, countIf(toHour(ts) = 23) AS `23`
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY day ORDER BY min(toDayOfWeek(ts))

panels.title: Last 30 days: API equivalent vs plan ($${plan_monthly}/month)
panels.description: cost_usd of the last 30 days (computed by Claude Code, an API-price equivalent, not a bill) and its ratio to the monthly plan chosen in the Plan variable. A ratio above 1 means the plan is cheaper than API prices. Ignores the time range; all other variables apply.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(cost_usd) AS api_equivalent, if(${plan_monthly} > 0, sum(cost_usd) / ${plan_monthly}, 0) AS payback_x
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY

panels.title: Tips (last 7 days)
panels.description: Total number of findings in cc.tips (usage tips over the last 7 days). Ignores the variables and the time range. Click the value to open the Tips section of the Efficiency dashboard. Colour: green = 0, yellow = 1 or more, orange = 5 or more.

targets.rawSql:

FROM (SELECT category, count() AS c FROM cc.tips GROUP BY category)

panels.title: Most frequent tip
panels.description: The most frequent category in cc.tips (usage tips over the last 7 days) with its count in brackets (ties: alphabetical order). Ignores the variables and the time range. Click the value to open the Tips section of the Efficiency dashboard.

targets.rawSql:

FROM (SELECT category, count() AS c FROM cc.tips GROUP BY category)

options.content:
**Tokens** (one model request = one row)

- **input**: new, uncached prompt tokens sent to the model.
- **output**: tokens the model generated.
- **cache read**: prompt tokens served from the prompt cache (cheap). Cache hit rate = cache read / (input + cache read + cache create).
- **cache create**: prompt tokens written to the cache (more expensive than input, paid once, then re-read cheaply).
- **Tokens** on the cards = input + output + cache read + cache create.

**cost_usd**: calculated by Claude Code itself from its price table: an API-price equivalent, not a bill. On a subscription plan you pay the flat fee instead; the "Last 30 days: API equivalent vs plan" panel compares the two.

**actor**: who made the request: `main` (the main conversation), an agent name (a subagent), or `aux:<query_source>` (background helper calls of Claude Code, for example title generation or compaction).

**aux**: such helper requests; they are not tied to a prompt you typed, but they cost tokens too.

**LIVE / IDLE**: a session with an event in the last 2 minutes / in the last 15 minutes.
